one_liner: Vonage offers self-serve communications APIs (Messages/SMS, Voice, Verify, Video) with free signup and JWT/key-based auth; per-customer credentials, no multi-user OAuth evidenced in the fetched pages.
auth_notes: Fetched pages confirm only that JWT authentication is available. API key/secret Basic auth and the absence of OAuth for core APIs are not verifiable from these pages (kept from the draft, low confidence). OAUTH2 removed because no fetched page supports it.
access_notes: Homepage invites visitors to create a free account. Network Features need operator approval for production use via Network Registry. Partner or reseller use (e.g. WhatsApp on behalf of others) requires becoming a Vonage partner. The €2 demo credit and 50-extension VBC claims are not on the fetched pages.
blocker_notes: Core APIs are self-serve. Network Features require operator approval for production; partner onboarding is needed only for acting on behalf of other businesses.
